title: Hot Air Events Austin
specs: Flights cruise under 2,000 feet with panoramic views of Texas hill country
Experienced pilots with decades of ballooning expertise
Pregnant women or possibly pregnant women not allowed to fly
Passengers must be able to climb in and out of basket; not wheelchair accessible
Passengers stand during flight; baskets have no seats
Wear closed-toe shoes, preferably tennis shoes; grass field launch and landing
Sign a release of liability waiver before flight
Basket capacity varies: some hold pilot plus 2 passengers, others 4-5 depending on weather and weight
Private groups and corporate events available

services.name: Balloon Glows
services.desc: Have you ever seen an 80 foot tall candle glowing beautifully in the night? It is a sight to behold! Invite us out to your evening event to bring a whole new level of decoration and scenic wonder as a hot air balloon lights up the night with it’s glowing radiance! Rates vary. Reach out to Kara our event specialist

includes: Champagne or cider toast, bottled water, and light snacks post-flight
Photos taken by crew before, during, and after flight sent by email
gap: Exact duration of flight not stated beyond typical 40-60 minutes
blurb: Guests experience a hot air balloon flight lasting 40 minutes to an hour, including setup and inflation time. Flights cruise at altitudes under 2,000 feet with panoramic views. Post-flight includes a champagne or cider toast, bottled water, and light snacks.
extraNote: All reservations made night before flight; full balance due day of flight even if no-show · Deposit $50 non-refundable but held until flight; no charge if flight canceled for weather · If weather unsafe, flight canceled and can reschedule or cancel · Weather decision made evening before and morning of flight; final check at launch site · Tips for pilot and crew appreciated, typically 10-20% of total cost · Old Settlers Association parking lot, across Hwy 79 from Kalahari resort, 3300 E Palm Valley Blvd, Round Rock, TX 78665; or at corner of River Ridge Rd and Market Street by the clock tower, 301 River Ridge Pkwy, San Marcos, TX 78666
